desc: the deye-sg05lp3 write policy, worked out - a whitelist: the chain reads top to bottom, the LAST matching rule decides, and a register no rule decides refuses (the default deny any)

rules.desc: the clean slate: nothing writable yet
operational mode registers (grid-start soc, grid charge current)
the TOU target socs and grid-charge enables
tou-time-1 (the schedule arm) stays read-only: the deny carves it out of the allowed span
the exceptions re-open: tou-soc-6 by hand, the last grid-charge enable
